HatchPattern__PondsAndLakes__Meta.Meta__Description: Ponds and lakes - the Ordnance Survey ripple mark, a shallow double crest, scattered loosely over still water. Used on any waterbody drawn as a closed face: ponds, lakes, the wide part of a river, a canal basin.
HatchPattern__PondsAndLakes__Meta.Meta__WhyTransparent: The tile paints RIPPLES ONLY. The blue wash beneath is the fill deck of the site plan composite, with its own colour and opacity, so it can be switched off on its own.
HatchPattern__PondsAndLakes__Meta.Meta__WhyPaperUnits: Paper millimetres, like every dash pattern in the editor, so a ripple is the same size on the sheet at any drawing scale.
HatchPattern__PondsAndLakes__Meta.Meta__WhySparse: Five ripples on a 15 x 11 mm tile. Water wants to read as mostly empty: a dense field of marks turns to texture and stops looking like water. The tile is deliberately NOT square, and its ripples sit at uneven heights, so the repeat does not line up into visible rows.

HatchPattern__PondsAndLakes__Identity.Identity__Description: How this pattern is named, found and grouped in the Patterns panel.
HatchPattern__PondsAndLakes__Identity.Identity__Note: Referenced by 71__SitePlan__BaseMap__Waterbodies in the Tags SSOT, through SitePlan__FillHatchId.

HatchPattern__PondsAndLakes__Tile.Tile__Description: The repeating cell, in paper millimetres.
HatchPattern__PondsAndLakes__Tile.Tile__Note: A landscape cell, because water marks read better spread sideways than stacked.

HatchPattern__PondsAndLakes__Defaults.Defaults__Description: A stroke colour of 'inherit' takes the layer's own line colour, so the ripples are blue because the waterbody layer is blue.

HatchPattern__PondsAndLakes__Glyphs.Glyphs__Description: Drawn about the glyph's base centre, y pointing DOWN, in tile millimetres.

Ripple.Glyph__Note: Two shallow crests - the OS still-water mark. Deliberately not a full sine: the flattened ends are what make it read as water rather than as a squiggle.

HatchPattern__PondsAndLakes__Placements.Place__Note: Straddles the right edge, so it knits to the tile alongside
Its other half, so the two meet exactly across the seam

HatchPattern__PondsAndLakes__Bounds.Bounds__Description: How far a viewport may scale and turn this pattern.
